## Changie Entry

**⚠️ IMPORTANT: This project uses [Changie](https://changie.dev/) for changelog management.**

Please add a changie entry for your changes by running:

```bash
changie new
```

This will prompt you to describe your change and automatically create a changelog entry file in `.changes/unreleased/`.

If you don't have changie installed, you can:
- Install it from: https://changie.dev/guide/installation/
- Or manually create a file in `.changes/unreleased/` following the existing format

### Why use Changie?

Changie helps us maintain an organized, automated changelog that:
- Makes release notes easier to generate
- Ensures all changes are documented
- Reduces merge conflicts in CHANGELOG.md
- Provides better visibility into what changed in each release
